headline: Inflation erodes Christmas bonus purchasing power in Dominican Republic
summary: Economist Winston Marte warned that elevated food costs are undermining the purchasing power of double-salary holiday bonuses for Dominican workers.
why: Dominican Republic labor laws mandate a 13th-month annual Christmas bonus for formal employees.

impacts.name: Dominican Republic
impacts.why: Food inflation reduces real disposable income gains from mandated year-end bonuses.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
